ota.url.description: Base URL of the OS image update source: the update window reads <url>/latest-<arch>.json there.

ota.auto_check.description: Check the update source now and then (about ten minutes after start and every six hours); a new update is announced, and installed only if ota.auto_update is on.

ota.auto_update.description: Install updates automatically: a service downloads and installs a newer signed update in the background (it starts at the next restart). Needs ota.auto_check.

system.developer_mode.description: Enable developer features. Changing it requires administrator authentication.
